findings.explanation: HOL4's RESULT_def has the single clause RESULT (Result t) = t. No saved theorem fixes RESULT on Clash. The Lean definition adds the clause RESULT (Clash t) = t, so Lean proves this specific equation by rfl, while HOL4 leaves it open. It also propagates to INST and INST_CORE, which apply RESULT to results that could be Clash.
findings.repair:
opaque RESULT_spec {α : Type u} : {f : result α → α // ∀ t, f (.Result t) = t} :=
  ⟨fun r => match r with | .Result t => t | .Clash t => t, fun _ => rfl⟩

def RESULT {α : Type u} (r : result α) : α := RESULT_spec.1 r

theorem RESULT_def {α : Type u} (t : α) : RESULT (.Result t) = t := RESULT_spec.2 t
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.HolSyntaxLib

theorem RESULT_Clash {α : Type} (t : α) : Candle.HolSyntaxLib.RESULT (Candle.HolSyntaxLib.result.Clash t) = t := rfl
findings.hol4_check: ?f : bool result -> bool. (!t. f (Result t) = t) /\ f (Clash T) <> T
